title: Democratic Impact Monitor: National Clean Air Water and Environmental Accountability Bill
objective: Track PM2.5/PM10 reduction, sensor network coverage, and industrial compliance.

indicators.name: PM2.5 Air Quality Target Compliance
indicators.definition: Annual average PM2.5 concentration across urban and rural sensor grids.

oversight.composition: Scientists, environmental judges, civil society nominees

triggers.condition: Air quality PM2.5 levels exceeding 50 µg/m³ for 3 consecutive days in any district.
triggers.interim_protection: Mandatory temporary shutdown of non-essential industrial emission sources
triggers.public_notice: Immediate public red alert published on open portal
